description.en: Liquid Glass UI theme for DeepSeek Harness: frosted glass surfaces with edge refraction, tintable colors, custom fonts, background images and dynamic wallpapers, custom CSS, and soft animations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的液态玻璃 UI 主题：磨砂玻璃+边缘折射、可调透明度/模糊/色调、自定义字体、背景图与动态壁纸（多图轮播）、自定义 CSS、柔和动画。
